name: teach-me
description: One adaptive education plugin for direct learning, teacher preparation, and age-appropriate teaching in English and simplified Modern Standard Arabic.

interface.longDescription: Teach Me turns ChatGPT into a patient, adaptive teacher for learners, educators, and parents. It teaches topics step by step, prepares classroom-ready lesson briefs, adapts explanations when an age is supplied, and supports source-grounded learning from files, PDFs, books, webpages, videos, playlists, courses, recordings, curricula, and mixed sources that ChatGPT can inspect. It clearly states source-access limits, supports English and simplified Modern Standard Arabic, and asks permission before routine assessments. Teach Me creates no account, stores no learner state, and its read-only connector receives no learner messages or source contents.
defaultPrompt: Teach me how compound interest works from zero, using a practical example.
حضّر لي درسًا مدته 20 دقيقة عن التمثيل الضوئي لطلاب عمرهم 12 سنة، وافصل ملاحظات المدرس عن الكلام الذي أقوله للطلاب.
Teach me from the PDF I attach. First tell me what you can inspect, then start with the first useful idea.
